The session library gains an in-process layout read keyed by the snapshot's string ids, refusing stale or not-found, that runs no step, pump, tick or settle, opens no span and emits no event.
No verb, MCP tool, socket call, kept check, snapshot node key, refusal cause or log field was added; the absence of every carrier of the read is PROVISIONAL on the delegate's answer, and v030-11 stays unclaimed.
Measured on the stand: every snapshot node on the six served screens answers with the snapshot's bounds in both layout modes; the stand's new layout check joins the three-round stand repeat; the read was shown to change nothing, focus, snapshot, diff, clock and an open list included.

Cognitive complexity ceiling of 15: two new functions read 17 and were split to meet it.

body_fields.fact: BaseDocument::layout_reason(NodeId) answers a LayoutReason (placement word, container, offset, shifts, a size reason per axis with its cause) or None for an unresolved id, a non-element, an element with no computed styles, or an element with no box (display none, display contents, or under a display none ancestor); it has no log site and no panic path.

The layout reason's closed words: PlacedBy is Block, Flex, Grid, Table, Inline, Float, Absolute, Fixed, Root, Select or SelectList; ShiftBy is Scroll or Transform; SizeCause is Style, Min, Max, FlexGrow, FlexShrink, Stretch, Grid, Table, Replaced, Content or Layout; Length is Auto, None, Px, Percent (0 to 100), Calc in px or a SizeKeyword (MinContent, MaxContent, FitContent, Stretch).
The cause of a size is a stated rule, first match wins, read at 1/64 px; a height percentage counts as definite only when its container's computed height is not auto.

Session::layout(id) is an in-process driver read answering a LayoutExplanation of String ids, closed words and numbers with no NodeId; it resolves its id as the run path does, refusing stale or not-found, records the screen's ids, and runs no step, pump, tick or settle and opens no span.
The layout read on the carriers is absent, PROVISIONAL on the founder's word at the epoch boundary: no verb, MCP tool, session socket call or kept check reaches Session::layout.
Placer::App with a canvas name is a reserved placing word of the driver's layout answer, built by no engine path; an app-placed canvas element is to take it.

An element the engine reader cannot explain reads Placer::Engine(Block) with its snapshot bounds, no container and both causes Layout, in process only; before the read crosses any carrier it is owed a closed word of its own.
A closed select's option reads the placing word Select at its select's box although the default sheet gives it display none; a closed select's optgroup, display contents, reads no layout reason.
A tolerance stated to 1/64 px is read inclusively, the absolute difference at most 1/64, since a sum of values each snapped to 1/64 can sit one unit from a separately snapped rect.

body:
The session added an in-process layout read: why an element sits where it does at its size, read from the style and layout chain (v030-11, built and not claimed).
The engine gained a read-only reader on every document, BaseDocument::layout_reason, answering a placing word (PlacedBy), shifts (Scroll, Transform) and a size cause per axis (SizeCause), or None for an unresolved, unstyled or boxless element; it has no log site and no panic path.
The driver gained Session::layout, which resolves an id through the run path's resolve (refusing stale or not-found) and answers String ids, closed words and numbers, never a NodeId; it runs no step, pump, tick or settle, opens no span and emits no event.
No verb, MCP tool, socket call, kept-check key, argument, result field, refusal cause, log field or span field was added; VERBS still holds fourteen; the absence of every carrier of the read is PROVISIONAL, for the founder's word.
Measured: the read changes nothing (snapshot, focus, diff, clock unchanged, delivered Timer ticks unapplied) and a TRACE capture during it reads 0 escher_ lines; escher-driver line coverage 97.99 % with every crate at or above its floor.

body_fields.what: new; the engine's layout reason reader on every document and its closed words (LayoutReason, PlacedBy, ShiftBy, SizeCause, Length, SizeKeyword) — no log site, no panic path
edited; the engine document crate's root, now declaring the layout reason module and re-exporting its types
edited; the native DOM crate's root re-exports, now carrying the layout reason types and BoundingRect beside NodeId
new; the driver's in-process layout read Session::layout and its answer types (LayoutExplanation, Placement, Placer with the reserved App canvas, ShiftReading)
new; the driver's unit tests of the layout answer (stable ids, unexplained element, reserved App placer)
edited; the driver's run path, its id resolve (now crate-visible, with stale and not-found refusals) and the command target
edited; the driver library root, declaring the layout module and re-exporting its answer types
new; the engine integration check reading every placing word and size cause on fixtures in both layout modes

new; the stand check of the layout read on the served screens, its no-change and no-pending-pass cases, its stale and not-found refusals, and its TRACE capture counting escher_ lines; in the stand-repeat set
edited by hand; the capability statement, gaining the layout read, its size rule and the absence of any carrier for it

body: decision/driver-emits-no-event and span-trace-coverage: a new driver surface, Session::layout, emits no event and opens no span, measured by a TRACE capture reading 0 escher_ lines; it belongs beside the rule.

decision/one-span-per-command and the command span contracts (command-span/span, escher-driver-command-span/span): the layout read is a driver read outside any command, with no span of its own; the command span itself is unmoved, a read beside the one-span rule.
contract/refusal-cause/stale and contract/refusal-cause/not-found: Session::layout now refuses with these two causes through the run path's resolve; no new cause was added.

decision/actions-read-changes-nothing: a second read that changes nothing in the document now stands beside it — the layout read runs no step, pump, tick or settle and leaves delivered Timer ticks unapplied.
decision/capability-statement-updated-by-hand: the capability statement was edited by hand for the layout read, its size rule and the absence of its carrier; its pin stays green in fast.
decision/driver-library-installs-no-subscriber: the driver library gained a module and still installs no subscriber; only a test-side capture subscriber reads the TRACE count.
decision/debug-types-never-logged and decision/session-logs-carry-no-page-content: a new answer-bearing type, LayoutExplanation, holds ids, closed words and numbers and is never logged.
decision/engine-target-safe-fields: the engine gained a reader with no log site, so no new engine target field.
contract/command-span/verb and contract/command-span/field-count: no verb was added (VERBS still fourteen) and no span field, so the verb set the command span carries is unmoved.
contract/tool-call-span/tool and contract/host-wire/v3: no MCP tool and no socket message reaches the layout read; the tool set and the host wire are unmoved.

decision/graph-and-actions-not-counted-verbs and the cold-agent counted verbs (advance, lint, screenshot): the layout read cannot be counted by a cold agent while it stays in process; no counted verb moves.
decision/hosted-call-through-session-run: Session::layout is a session method reached by no hosted call, so the rule holds; it resolves ids through the same resolve as the run path.
decision/driver-spans-carry-no-content and decision/command-span-no-call-content: the layout read adds no span, so no span carries its id or answer.

body_fields.fact: The driver's in-process layout read opens no span and emits no event; it runs outside the command span, and a TRACE capture during it reads 0 escher_ lines.

The layout read changes nothing: it runs no step, pump, tick or settle; the snapshot, both focus readings, the diff and the clock are unchanged, an open list stays open and delivered Timer ticks stay unapplied.
The layout read's answer holds String ids, closed words (placer, shift, size cause, length) and numbers only — no text, no value, no NodeId — and is never logged.
The layout read has no carrier: no verb, MCP tool, socket call or kept check reaches it, and VERBS stays fourteen — a PROVISIONAL absence awaiting the founder's word.
The cold-agent bar cannot count the layout read while it stays in process.

The engine's layout reason reader has no log site and no panic path; it answers None for an unresolved id, a non-element, an unstyled element or a boxless one (display none, display contents, or a display none ancestor).

body: Telemetry backend, metric emission and metrics exporter absences, and the WPT score publishing decisions: no exporter, metric or backend was added.
escher's sink log line format, its RUST_LOG, stream, service.name and service.version, the target allowlist and the scrub set: the sink was not changed.
The tool_call span's fields and endings and the closed span line's field order, quoting and timing: no span was added or altered.
The agent-run and cold-agent harness events, verdict fields and transcript decisions: no harness or verdict field moved.
Script error surface, window error event, onerror, WPT report and escher-telemetry panic hook rows: no error path was touched.
CI integration, uploaded artifacts, recording files, session state directory and recording bounds: no CI step, recording or state file changed.
escher-session commands, exit codes, the coverage role line, the mcp role stdout and the error object: no binary role or exit status changed.
The select, optgroup and open-list logging and pixel decisions: the layout read names a select's box by a placing word but logs no label, chosen set or row.

body_fields.because: The absence of every carrier of the layout read is applied provisional, so its end-to-end tier holds no test until the founder's word, and no row says so.

body_fields.name: Every layout reader word read on a fixture
body_fields.rule: Every placing word and every size cause of the layout reader is read on a fixture node in both layout modes, from tables that count their rows.
body_fields.because: The chunk adds the layout reader's closed words and holds each one to a fixture reading, a coverage rule a new word must meet.

body:
The session added a layout read that explains why an element sits where it does at its size: an engine reader on every document, BaseDocument::layout_reason, and a driver reader, Session::layout, both in process only.
The engine reader is read-only: it answers None for an unresolved id, a non-element, an unstyled element or a boxless element, has no log site and no panic path; a closed select's option reads Select at its select's box.
The driver reader takes an id from Rust code alone, resolves it through the run path's resolve (refusing stale or not-found), records the screen's ids, runs no step, pump, tick or settle, opens no span, and answers String ids, closed words and numbers, never a NodeId.
No carrier reaches the read: no verb, argument, MCP tool, socket message, kept-check key, span field, env var or refusal cause was added; VERBS still holds fourteen. That absence is PROVISIONAL on the delegate's answer to the founder fork, pending the founder's word.
An element the engine cannot explain reads Placer::Engine(PlacedBy::Block) in process; the wrap directive owes it a closed word of its own before the answer crosses any carrier. Placer::App with a canvas string is reserved and built only by unit tests.
Measured: escher-driver line coverage 97.99 percent against a 98.05 percent baseline, coverage floors all held; a pump on a settled screen was disproved as a control of a changes-nothing read.

edited; the driver crate root, its Session and its public exports
edited; the committed capability statement, what each carrier crosses and what is absent
new file; the engine-level integration test of every placing word and size cause on fixtures
new file; the stand integration test of the driver layout read, that it changes nothing, refuses stale and not-found ids and writes no escher line at TRACE

body: The boundary widening rule and closed-value-field-no-widening: a new public in-process read was added that crosses no carrier; the rule over what counts as a widening now has a reader that answers closed words and numbers but reaches no carrier.

One validation path for every carrier and the single command validation gate: the driver's id resolver was made crate-visible so the layout read resolves its id through the same path as the run path's id-taking arms.

Unknown id refused as stale or not-found, caller-supplied id looked up anew, and the driver id refusal contract items stale and not-found: a new caller of the same resolution, refusing with those two causes.
Bounded id record fed by the session and the bounded in-process record of read ids: the layout read records the screen's ids into that record.

No NodeId kept between calls, no process-local handle crosses with an id, and the stable element id's NodeId contract item: the layout answer holds String stable ids and no NodeId; the engine reader's own types do hold NodeIds and stay in process.
Ratified exits of the stable id and the stable element id's carriers: the stable id now also leaves through an in-process layout answer, which no ratified carrier carries.
Fixed order of target refusals and the actions read sharing one target check: the target type gains a crate-visible node accessor used only by the layout read.

Actions read runs nothing and moves no session state: the layout read makes the same promise (no step, pump, tick or settle; snapshot, focus, diff, clock and open list unchanged; delivered Timer ticks stay unapplied).

Text extent reader read-only with none answers, stale node ids never panic and no panic on call-supplied input: a second engine reader of the same kind, answering None for an unresolved, non-element, unstyled or boxless node, with no log site and no panic path.

Select readers resolve the node and skip an open list, and select row layout reads none for an unstyled row: the layout reader reads a closed select's option as Select at its select's box, and a closed select's optgroup reads None.
Visible region read through transforms and non-invertible transform takes no hit: the layout reader reports transform and scroll shifts, including a scale(0) transform, from the unrounded geometry.
Closed driver verb schema and the driver verbs contract: VERBS still holds fourteen; no layout verb or argument kind was added, and the layout read is reached by no verb.
Committed statement of the MCP crossing: the committed capability statement gained the layout read, its size rule and the absence of any carrier for it; its pin stays green.

One command span per call, command span holds no content, driver installs no subscriber and driver outcomes never logged: the layout read opens no span and emits no event; TRACE capture reads zero escher lines.

Per-crate line coverage floors: escher-driver measured 97.99 percent against the 98.05 percent baseline, still at or above its floor; where a row holds a floor value or baseline for escher-driver, it is the one to check.

Threat Model Summary crossings (actions, graph, coverage, MCP result, select list): a new reading of each element's placement and size exists in process, held off every crossing until the founder rules.

body_fields.fact: The engine layout reader BaseDocument::layout_reason is read-only and in process; it answers None for an unresolved id, a non-element, an element with no computed styles or one with no box, reads the unrounded geometry, and has no log site and no panic path.

The driver layout read Session::layout takes its id from Rust code alone, resolves it through the run path's resolve (stale or not-found), records the read ids, runs no step, pump, tick or settle, and answers String stable ids, closed words and numbers, with no NodeId, text or value.

No carrier reaches the layout read: no verb, MCP tool, socket call or kept check; this absence is PROVISIONAL on the delegate's option 2 to the founder fork, pending the founder's word at the epoch boundary.
An element the engine cannot explain reads Placer::Engine(PlacedBy::Block) in process only; before the layout answer crosses any carrier it must take a closed word of its own.
Placer::App with a canvas string is a reserved placer word that no path outside the driver's unit tests builds; no app-supplied string reaches the layout answer.
The layout read opens no span and emits no event; at TRACE it writes no escher line.

body: Authentication and authorization: CI tokens, publish guards and the absence of application authentication are not reached; no listener, peer or credential changed.
Data protection: history, cookies, HTTP cache, clipboard, file dialog, TLS, kept-check files and cold-agent recordings are not reached; the layout read writes nothing to disk.
Dependency security: no dependency, pin, audit ignore, licence or CI action changed.
Secret management: no environment variable, secret or signing material was added or read.
API security's outbound side: outbound HTTP, per-host limits, load waits, idle expiry, script fetch methods, CORS and same-origin absences are not reached.
The session socket and MCP server wire: request grammar, bounds, replies, protocol errors, tool results and exit codes are unchanged, since nothing crosses them.
Password and file value masking, recorded checks, recording directories, cold-agent runs and the select list's keys, paint, wheel and choice paths are not reached.
WPT runner, upstream sync and CI workflow rows are not reached.

The session added an in-process layout read: why an element sits where it does at its size, from the style and layout chain (v030-11, built and not claimed).
blitz-dom gains a read-only reader on every document, BaseDocument::layout_reason, answering a placing word (PlacedBy), shifts (Scroll, Transform) and per-axis size causes (SizeCause), or None for an unresolved id, a non-element, an unstyled element or a box-less element; a closed select's option reads Select.
escher-driver gains Session::layout, in process only: it resolves its id through the run path's resolve (stale, not-found), answers String ids, closed words and numbers, runs no step, pump, tick or settle, and opens no span; no verb, MCP tool, socket call or kept check reaches it, and that absence of every carrier is PROVISIONAL.
Two new blitz-tests targets, layout_reason and stand_layout, run in both layout modes; stand_layout joins stand-repeat by its prefix and declares session_common; a unit-test child module covers the driver read.
Measured: the plan's pump control of the no-change read did not hold (a pump on a settled screen changes nothing), so a Timer case with delivered, unapplied ticks was added and the control then held; escher-driver line coverage read 97.99 % against a 98.05 % baseline, every floor still held; two functions over the complexity ceiling of 15 were split.
No verb, argument, result field, refusal cause, log field or span field was added; VERBS still holds fourteen and the capability pin stays green.

body: The one-test-target-per-file and one-target-per-behaviour decisions: blitz-tests gains two targets, layout_reason and stand_layout, each one file and one behaviour.
The blitz-tests manifest decisions (single test target, difference from upstream): two new target files join the tests directory.
The both-layout-modes decisions for stand checks and layout assertions: both new targets loop every case over incremental false and true.
The stand-repeat decisions (three rounds, zero-failure budget, a file joining a leg keeps its legs): stand_layout joins stand-repeat by its stand_ prefix, read 3 of 3 rounds green.
The per-crate coverage floor decisions and the coverage leg gated by the floors: escher-driver line coverage moved to 97.99 % from a 98.05 % baseline; every crate still holds its floor.
The cognitive-complexity ceiling read on the host (15): two new functions read 17 and were split to fit, one a stand check's test body.

The capability statement pinned to the driver schema and the claim section names and counts held to it: the statement gained the layout read and its carrier absence, VERBS still fourteen, the pin green in the fast leg.
Capability claims name their checks: the layout read's claim is held by layout_reason and stand_layout, and v030-11 stays unclaimed.
The contrast reader changes nothing decision: a second reader on the document now carries the same read-only rule, asserted by stand_layout's no-change cases.
Session checks share one module and shared stand tables in one module: session_common gains a declarer, stand_layout.
The driver session's stale and not-found contract and its record of ids: the layout read resolves its id through the run path's resolver, refuses stale or not-found, and records the screen's ids.
The driver session's reading verbs, run carriers and the verb table: the layout read is a Session method in process only and no verb or carrier; the absence of every carrier is PROVISIONAL.
The cold-agent wrong-call bar: it cannot count the layout read while the read stays in process.
Tests controlled red-before-green: the plan's pump control of the no-change read read DOES NOT HOLD on a settled screen and held only on an added Timer case with pending ticks.
Table-driven tests assert their row count: layout_reason's placing table holds 13 rows over 11 words and its size table 11 rows over 11 causes.
Stand timer driven by delivered ticks and timer driven by delivered ticks: stand_layout delivers Timer ticks and reads them unapplied through the read.
Settle never advances time and the harness core pump: the layout read runs no step, pump, tick or settle.
No ids or names in stand logs, session logs nothing of the screen and sink capture counted by target: stand_layout's TRACE capture of the read counts 0 escher_ lines.
A scrolled box reads where it stands: the layout read gives a scrolled holder's child a Scroll shift held by its holder, with the holder's own bounds unmoved.
Parsed markup pinned with the real parser and blitz-dom fixtures built without the HTML parser: layout_reason's fixtures are HTML pages built through the harness's from_html_with.
Unit tests in inline modules and split test modules keep their paths: the driver read's unit tests sit in a path-attributed child module of the layout module.
Stand checks on the bundled font, no skip, and the seven_guis headless stand boots: stand_layout holds served screens, the Timer and cells boots, in both modes.
The harness inspection layout_rect contract: the layout read answers the snapshot's bounds and an offset chain that holds to 1/64 px beside it.

body_fields.fact: A control of a read that must change nothing needs pending work a pass would apply; a pump on a settled screen is invisible and no control.
A tolerance stated as to 1/64 px is read inclusively, the absolute difference at most 1/64, since a sum of values each snapped to 1/64 can sit one unit from a separately snapped rect.
The layout read changes nothing: no change pending, snapshot, focus, diff and clock unchanged, an open list stays open and delivered Timer ticks stay unapplied, asserted on the stand in both modes.
The layout read has no session, command-line, MCP or kept-check test, as it has no carrier; that absence is PROVISIONAL until the founder's word.
Every placing word and every size cause of the layout reader is read on a fixture node in both layout modes, its tables counting their rows.
